content.alt: A Geographer stands with the proud geographer icon 'Bijoypur white clay hill' of her place or origin, Netrokona, Bangladesh.

content.text: This is Muna Khan. An ambitious person with a research interest in public health. I persuaded a bechelor and a master degree in Geography and Environmental Study from University of Chittagong and currently working as an Assistant-MIS (Management Information System) in one of the leading international NGOs 'Save the Children International'.

From my early graduation, i was enthusiast in research and worked in multiple public health research on environmental health, occupational health, e-waste management, Covid-19 induced diseases etc.My academic thesis was on the street children in Chattogram city that assessed infectious diseases, Wash, substance use, nutrition status and harmful sexual practices of the street children.

Later, I worked with Bangladesh Institute of Innovative Health Research- BIIHR on public health issues like PCOS, Obesity, Nutrition, Mental health, Reproductive health and healthcare system such as Telemedicine, Oncology, Collaborative care etc.

At present, i am working in Rohingya Refugee context in Cox’s bazar in Child protection (CP) sector with database including case management database (CPIMS+), Activity tracker and Group enrollment tracker (Prevention database). My core responsibility is to report monthly activity progress, donor indicator wise progress, case management data and total reach of Rohingya children.

Hence, I successfully implemented my core research interest public health with data driven approach and working with the extremely vulnerable Rohingya migrants in such a challenging locational setting also highlights my outlook as a Geographer.
In future, i aspire to acquire an MPH degree in Health Informatics and in far future i dream to pursue a PhD on vulnerablity in emergency context.
